mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
co.company_name DESC, p.person_id ps.code_name DESC, p.person_id p.access_end_dt DESC, p.person_id p.reg_dt DESC, p.person_id p.person_id DESC

p.person_id, p.person_name, p.birth_date, p.person_phone, p.company_code, p.title_code, p.person_type, p.status_code, p.main_task, p.remark, p.biostar_user_id, CONVERT(varchar(10), p.access_start_dt, 23) AS access_start_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), p.access_end_dt, 23) AS access_end_dt, p.use_yn, p.del_yn, p.reg_dt, p.mod_dt, co.company_name AS company_name, ut.code_name AS title_name, ps.code_name AS status_name

FROM tb_person p LEFT JOIN tb_company co ON co.company_code = p.company_code LEFT JOIN tb_common ut ON ut.cmm_id = 'UT' AND ut.code_id = p.title_code LEFT JOIN tb_common ps ON ps.cmm_id = 'PS' AND ps.code_id = p.status_code
mapper.select:
SELECT
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_person (person_id, person_name, birth_date, person_phone, company_code, title_code, person_type, status_code, main_task, access_start_dt, access_end_dt, remark, use_yn) VALUES (#{personId}, #{personName}, #{birthDate}, #{personPhone}, #{companyCode}, #{titleCode}, #{personType}, #{statusCode}, #{mainTask}, #{accessStartDt}, #{accessEndDt}, #{remark}, ISNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y'))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_person SET person_name = #{personName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, person_phone = #{personPhone}, company_code = #{companyCode}, title_code = #{titleCode}, status_code = #{statusCode}, main_task = #{mainTask}, access_start_dt = #{accessStartDt}, access_end_dt = #{accessEndDt}, remark = #{remark}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE person_id = #{personId}
UPDATE tb_person SET del_yn = 'Y', mod_dt = getdate() WHERE person_id = #{personId}
